name: Schematron V2 Small
title: Schematron V2 Small: price, context window and specs
answer: Schematron V2 Small is a model in Inference.net's Inference.net Schematron family, first listed on 2026-09-12. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 128K tokens and up to 4K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.05 per million input tokens and $0.23 per million output tokens. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as inference-net/schematron-v2-llama-3.2-3b, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
compare: It is the oldest of the 2 versions of Inference.net Schematron still listed.
Its input price is the family median, $0.05 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
